characterDescription: Sir Gais Wyrm, the young adult knight in the exact Image 1: fair skin, the same short richly rust-red tousled hair and asymmetrical fringe, subtle crown tufts, narrow amber-brown eyes, youthful fine angular jaw, straight brows, clean-shaven face. Preserve his precise illustrated anime linework, sharp restrained cel shading, warm original palette and age; no beard, longer hair, muscular adult redesign or different eye shape. Preserve the dark charcoal/black plate armor, modest thin gold edging, rounded dark pauldrons, high black gorget, gold/yellow central breastplate with the BLACK Wyrm dragon, black sleeves and black gloves from the source. Extend the original armor down to waist/upper thighs with a practical belt, retaining its exact design. Do not replace the avatar armor with a chainmail-only outfit from an older equipment entry. No helmet, shield, horse, sword or extra weapon.

panels.gesture: Cool narrowed eyes and firm jaw; RIGHT hand drives a compact diagonal cut downward and outward below his unobstructed face, LEFT hand loosely lifted beside ribs for balance.

Sharp focused stare with a short open-mouth exertion; RIGHT hand extends the sword into an oblique thrust beside torso toward the outer tile, LEFT arm drawn back naturally. Avoid blade aimed into camera.
A small smug smile and measuring sideward gaze; RIGHT sword carried low beside hip, torso modestly turned as he changes the angle, LEFT palm partly open near belt.
Calm concentrated eyes and tight mouth; RIGHT hand holds blade diagonally beside shoulder in a compact defensive guard, LEFT forearm below chin and clear of cutting edge, face completely visible.

Teeth briefly clenched with effort, alert amber-brown eyes; RIGHT hand braces hilt at lower chest, blade angled outward to deflect an unseen strike, LEFT hand can support the lower HILT with no fingers on blade.
Calculating sideways eyes and slightly lifted brow; small lateral torso movement, RIGHT sword in safe low guard alongside hip, LEFT hand relaxed and balancing.
Uploaded avatar's self-assured mild arrogance, easy half-lidded eyes and faint smile; RIGHT hand holds sword lowered with tip safely outside frame, LEFT hand rests on belt.
Direct confident gaze and a brief challenging open mouth; LEFT gloved index finger points toward unseen counterpart offscreen, RIGHT hand keeps sword safely low at his own side, realistic hand size.

Small cheek abrasion, slight brow bruise and dusty armor, tired but stubborn eyes; RIGHT hand holds sword low, LEFT palm presses his sore ribs, a small bend at torso and strained closed lips. Conscious, not defeated, same armor.

status: erzeugt, mit V3 zerlegt und visuell geprüft
weapon: Exactly ONE Gais inventory longsword in his RIGHT gloved hand, matching Image 2: straight double-edged plain steel blade with tapering point, modest golden straight/slightly swept crossguard, black leather-wrapped hilt and round gold pommel with a BLACK Wyrm dragon. Normal longsword size, never an oversized greatsword, dagger, curved saber or spear. The RIGHT hand wraps the HILT behind the crossguard, never the blade; the LEFT gloved hand remains free for balancing and gesturing, except a natural two-handed guard may support the lower hilt. No shield, second sword, lance or horse.
background: Gemeinsames ruhiges mittelalterliches Übungsfeld bei weichem Tageslicht.
framing: Vollständiger Kopf bis Hüfte/oberer Oberschenkel; Hände und Schaftgriffe lesbar.
